_note: Config snapshot for exp-017 (Issue #16 / issue #46 S4): four end-to-end MuSiQue answering cells on components/answerer/run_answerer.py, all on the ADR 0007 pinned 600 (200/hop), same reader and context policy, so they are directly comparable. configs/answer_musique.json is unedited; this snapshot embeds it verbatim (via each cell's own answer_config.json, identical shared_config block across all 4 cells) plus the exact CLI invocations run per cell, taken from runs/exp-017/run_all.sh.

oracle.note: restricts itself to the pinned 600 by id; only gold sub-question TEXT read, never gold sub-answers, per ADR 0019

full_train.note: identified as exp-008's real full_train run (not its sibling runs/exp-008/20260822_100736/, a 5-row dry-run fixture with the same condition:unguided label) by cross-checking runs/exp-008/20260822_100745/notes.md and runs/exp-008/arm_comparison/full_train/eval_config.json.predictions, both pointing at this exact path

unguided.note: identified as exp-004's unguided condition (not oracle_guided or unguided_capped) from its own config.json (condition:unguided, guided:false), not from the directory name

no_decomposition_control.note: lead-added, not an ADR 0019 condition, pending Jahid's and his supervisor's acceptance. A 600-row predictions file built from exp-004 unguided's query_id/question/hop_count fields with decomposition set to the original question verbatim as a single step (no sub-questions), the same construction as the decomposition-quality junk battery's J2_question_echo row (scripts/decomposition_junk_battery.py), executed through the answerer's normal --predictions path with no new code and no new model. Measures reader accuracy on the full multi-hop question with the same full-paragraph context as the other 3 cells - a no-decomposition baseline, explicitly not a no-context/closed-book baseline.

scoring: SQuAD official evaluation script (normalize_answer / get_tokens / compute_exact / compute_f1) as adopted by MuSiQue's metrics/answer.py, score taken as the maximum over the gold answer set (metric_max_over_ground_truths) and macro-averaged over items (AnswerMetric). Verified against upstream StonyBrookNLP/musique @ main and by a 20,000-pair differential test against the official SQuAD script, 0 mismatches; see src/answer_metrics.py
